title: Recall of Patient Invoices & Statements Accounts from the Collection Agency
content:
A Patient Invoices & Statements invoice placed with the collection agency is recalled only where its billing class allows recall, and only for one of three reasons.

## Recall reasons

1. A financial-assistance award covering the invoice was approved.
2. A billing error was confirmed on the invoice.
3. A claim for the invoice's order is being reprocessed.

A patient's promise to pay, or a request to stop collection calls, is not a recall reason. The patient pays the agency or the laboratory directly, and any payment received by the laboratory is applied to the placed invoice.

On recall the invoice returns to open; the date it was placed with the agency stays on the invoice as history of the placement.

## Recall in combination

| Class allows recall | Reason is one of the three listed | Recalled |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Yes | No | No |
| No | any | No |

## Questions answered

**A patient with a placed invoice promises to pay the balance next month and asks for the account to be taken back from the agency.** A promise to pay is not a recall reason; the invoice stays placed, and a payment the laboratory receives from the patient is applied to the placed invoice.

**A placed invoice turns out to carry a confirmed billing error.** A confirmed billing error is a recall reason; where the billing class allows recall, the invoice is recalled and is open again.

**A patient asks only that the collection calls stop.** A request to stop collection calls is not a recall reason.
